messages.subject: Webpage with links to pdf's on Distance Sampling
parts:
Hi List,

I have set up a web page with direct links to pdf format documents
(Adobe Acrobat files) on the use and application of Distance Sampling
methods. These are all available for free download. The address is

<http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distance_pdfs.htm>
http://www.creem.st-and.ac.uk/tiago/webpages/distance_pdfs.htm

I would appreciate that, if you know link(s) to other references, either
yours or from other authors, you could let me know (me, not the list, as
there is no need to fill up hundreds of mail boxes with such e-mails). I
would appreciate if the reference came in the following HTML format (use
as template if you like)

<a href="http://dolphin.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/hedley.pdf"> Author(s)
name(s)</a>
(date). Title of paper.
<i>Journal</i>.
<b>Volume</b>, Startpage-Endpage.

This way, it would be easy for me to get it in the webpage. However, if
you have a link and don't want to bother setting up the reference in the
above format, send me the link(s) and I'll do it.

Tiago Marques
